data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, even if others choose 10—not an all-or-nothing deal. Fisher01–25: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Each switch from 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra if filled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). All 18 leaves 50, with next stock 500 or 100: recovery isn't guaranteed, nor is long-run optimality. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Fisher07/22, help recruit.
